summary_en: MORESCO raised its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending February 2027 to 95 yen per share from 55 yen, with the interim dividend unchanged at 25 yen and the year-end dividend increased by 40 yen to 70 yen. The revision reflects upward earnings revisions driven by higher automotive production outside China, raw material price increases, and strong demand for high-value products.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Consolidated Business Performance Forecast and Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending February 2027 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
MORESCO Corporation revised its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending February 28, 2027, increasing the annual dividend per share to 95 yen from the previously forecast 55 yen. The interim dividend remains at 25 yen, while the year-end dividend was raised by 40 yen to 70 yen per share.

The revision was prompted by upward revisions to consolidated earnings forecasts. Operating profit is now expected at 4.5 billion yen, up 87.5% from the prior forecast of 2.4 billion yen, while ordinary profit is projected at 4.8 billion yen (up 77.8%) and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders at 2.8 billion yen (up 80.6%). The company attributed these improvements to increased automobile production outside China, which drove higher sales of die-casting lubricants and other oil products, price corrections following raw material price increases, and strong performance in high-value products including hard disk surface lubricants for data centers.

Under the company's basic dividend policy, which targets a consolidated dividend payout ratio of 30% or above over the medium term, the revised payout ratio for fiscal 2027 is expected to reach approximately 31%.
